templates.why_chosen: A software instance of the template: per-host Mint-agent/collector components connect via numbered, colored arrows to a separate Mint-backend, with a below-figure icon legend decoding the common-pattern, variable-parameter, and bloom-filter glyphs used on both sides.
templates.what_to_learn: Host-device does not require hardware: split a per-host agent from its backend service the same way, reuse one small icon set (pattern/parameter/metadata glyphs) on both sides so the legend only has to be defined once, and color the arrows by what they always report versus what they only report when sampled.
